active_evidence: Official HTTPS homepage and menu loaded on 2026-07-18; publishes slogan, dining occasions, menu, extensive wine-cellar claim, reservation phones, Batel address and current 2026 footer. Desktop/mobile captures completed.
problems: The current homepage is a minimal slideshow-style presentation that buries menu and reservation decisions below generic intro copy.
The strongest differentiators—multiple dining occasions and the 600-label cellar—are presented as isolated paragraphs rather than a coherent conversion narrative.
Reservations are phone-only and not visually prioritized for a visitor deciding between lunch, event, or romantic dinner.
The site uses a dated image-and-text structure with limited mobile information hierarchy.
The page does not turn the menu, adega, and address into a compact pre-visit confidence path.
rebuild_angle: Make 'Comer bem em todos os detalhes' tangible through an occasion-led trattoria experience: choose the moment, preview the menu/adega, then call for a reservation with Batel context.
roi_mechanism: Increase reservation intent from existing brand/search traffic by surfacing menu, occasion, phone, address, and wine-cellar proof without forcing exploratory scrolling.

observed_issue_urls_date.note: Minimal slideshow hierarchy, buried reservation action, and weak mobile decision path observed in official captures.

concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Porcini Trattoria because it stages the verified promise of being called to serve around the exact occasion a guest is planning.
concept_rules: Open with the verified slogan and an occasion selector: family, business, or romantic.
Use a subtle wine-cellar arch motif to create recognition beyond logo and color.
Pair culinary serif display type with a highly legible sans for practical booking facts.
Use official food/interior photography as framed windows, never generic stock plates.
Let burgundy and gold move from logo-derived anchors into warm paper surfaces with disciplined contrast.
Make menu, adega, reservation phones, and Batel address the final uninterrupted conversion sequence.
factual_claim_sources: Official home and menu pages plus official image URLs; all menu, cellar, contact, and address facts must remain bounded to those sources.
